title: FREE REQUEST (CLOSED) Seeking Concept artist/Main artist for horror visual novel

posts.author: Shinguccci
posts.body:
I'm a writer primarily more than an artist or a game dev. Currently I'm working on a project in RPG Maker MZ, akin to a corpse party or zero escape in gameplay and visuals (top down puzzle game). The basic concepts are already there: Characters, Locations, Plot.
All I need is an artist to help with concept art and possibly official art to realize the vision better before moving forward in development. I myself am I doing the writing and programming of the game, I'm just lacking when it comes to art.
Link to a GDD for the project is here:
https://docs.google.com/document/d/1_ZogvTdEvwrvnzO25_R2fdfShYJY022SJpPznYOQufs/edit?usp=sharing
If you're interested, shoot me a message on discord @ succubxtchh
